name: year
description: Federal fiscal year of the disclosure file the case was published in, running from 1 October to 30 September
observations: Partition column. Fiscal year, 1 October to 30 September, taken from the source file rather than from any date in the row

name: case_number
description: Case number assigned by the Office of Foreign Labor Certification, unique within the fiscal year
observations: Case number formats differ across the eFile, iCERT and FLAG systems; uniqueness is guaranteed only within a fiscal year

name: case_status
description: Outcome of the application at the time the file was published

name: visa_class
description: Visa classification of the certification, H-2B for temporary non-agricultural work

name: received_date
description: Date the application was received by the Department of Labor

name: decision_date
description: Date the Department of Labor issued its determination on the application

name: employment_begin_date
description: First day of the requested period of employment

name: employment_end_date
description: Last day of the requested period of employment

name: employer_name
description: Legal business name of the employer filing the application

name: employer_trade_name
description: Trade name or doing-business-as name of the employer

name: employer_address
description: First line of the employer's business address

name: employer_city
description: City of the employer's business address

name: employer_state
description: USPS two-letter abbreviation of the state of the employer's business address
observations: USPS abbreviation. Not linked to the US state directory, which is keyed on the FIPS code; referential coverage is checked by a dbt test instead

name: employer_postal_code
description: ZIP code of the employer's business address

name: employer_country
description: Country of the employer's business address

name: naics_id
description: North American Industry Classification System code of the employer's industry
observations: NAICS vintage follows the year of filing and code length varies from 2 to 6 digits, so codes are not linked to a directory

name: job_title
description: Job title of the position offered, as written by the employer

name: soc_id
description: Standard Occupational Classification code of the position offered
observations: SOC vintage follows the year of filing (SOC 2000, 2010 or 2018), so codes are not comparable across the whole series and are not linked to a directory

name: soc_title
description: Standard Occupational Classification title of the position offered

name: full_time_position
description: Whether the position offered is full time

name: wage_offered_from
description: Wage offered to the worker, at the bottom of the offered range, in the unit given by wage_unit_of_pay

name: wage_offered_to
description: Wage offered to the worker, at the top of the offered range, in the unit given by wage_unit_of_pay

name: wage_unit_of_pay
description: Period the offered wage refers to, harmonised by Data Basis to hour, day, week, bi-weekly, semi-monthly, month, year or piece rate
observations: Harmonised by Data Basis from vocabularies that differ by year and program (Hour, HR, Hourly all become hour)

name: wage_offered_from_annual
description: Offered wage at the bottom of the range converted to an annual amount by Data Basis, null when the unit is missing or is a piece rate
observations: Derived by Data Basis: the offered wage multiplied by 2080 for hourly, 260 for daily, 52 for weekly, 26 for bi-weekly, 24 for semi-monthly and 12 for monthly pay. Null when the unit is absent or is a piece rate

name: wage_offered_to_annual
description: Offered wage at the top of the range converted to an annual amount by Data Basis, null when the unit is missing or is a piece rate
observations: Derived by Data Basis using the same factors as wage_offered_from_annual

name: prevailing_wage
description: Prevailing wage determined for the occupation and area, in the unit given by prevailing_wage_unit_of_pay
observations: Not published from FY2016; only the determination case number survives in prevailing_wage_tracking_number

name: prevailing_wage_unit_of_pay
description: Period the prevailing wage refers to, harmonised by Data Basis to hour, day, week, bi-weekly, semi-monthly, month, year or piece rate
observations: Harmonised by Data Basis in the same way as wage_unit_of_pay

name: prevailing_wage_annual
description: Prevailing wage converted to an annual amount by Data Basis, null when the unit is missing or is a piece rate
observations: Derived by Data Basis using the same factors as wage_offered_from_annual

name: prevailing_wage_tracking_number
description: Tracking or case number of the prevailing wage determination issued for the application

name: worksite_address
description: First line of the address of the primary worksite

name: worksite_city
description: City of the primary worksite
observations: Primary worksite only. Applications covering several worksites list the rest in the companion Appendix A and Addendum B files, which are not part of this table

name: worksite_county
description: County of the primary worksite

name: worksite_state
description: USPS two-letter abbreviation of the state of the primary worksite
observations: USPS abbreviation. Not linked to the US state directory, which is keyed on the FIPS code; referential coverage is checked by a dbt test instead

name: worksite_postal_code
description: ZIP code of the primary worksite

name: attorney_law_firm_name
description: Business name of the law firm or agency representing the employer

name: agent_representing_employer
description: Whether an attorney or agent represents the employer on the application

name: application_type
description: Type of temporary labor certification application filed

name: certification_begin_date
description: First day of the certified period of employment

name: certification_end_date
description: Last day of the certified period of employment

name: requested_begin_date
description: First day of the period of need stated by the employer

name: requested_end_date
description: Last day of the period of need stated by the employer

name: nature_of_temporary_need
description: Nature of the employer's temporary need, such as seasonal or peak load

name: cap_exempt
description: Whether the application is exempt from the H-2B statutory cap

name: type_of_employer
description: Type of employer filing the application

name: job_order_number
description: Job order number assigned by the state workforce agency

name: job_order_submit_date
description: Date the job order was submitted to the state workforce agency

name: swa_state
description: State workforce agency that received the job order

name: workers_requested
description: Number of workers requested by the employer

name: workers_certified
description: Number of workers certified by the Department of Labor

name: anticipated_number_of_hours
description: Number of hours of work anticipated per week

name: overtime_rate_from
description: Overtime rate offered, at the bottom of the offered range

name: overtime_rate_to
description: Overtime rate offered, at the top of the offered range

name: msa_name
description: Name of the metropolitan statistical area or OES wage area of the worksite

name: education_level
description: Minimum level of education required for the job opportunity

name: work_experience_months
description: Months of work experience required for the job opportunity

name: source_file
description: Name of the Department of Labor disclosure file the row was read from
observations: Provenance. Names the Department of Labor workbook the row came from, which identifies the form version behind the row
